verdict.rationale: Docs clearly describe two install modes: a project-local mode where the CLI 'writes editable skill files into your project' that you own and commit (docs-2, docs-24, docs-47), versus a marketplace/plugin mode where you 'subscribe to the set as a read-only, always-current bundle' via Claude Code's official plugin marketplace (docs-1, docs-41, docs-10), which is installed once rather than per-repo. This maps to the project-local vs. broader-scope distinction in the story, though the docs never explicitly confirm the plugin install is user-global across all projects (vs. also being repo-scoped) or show independent hands-on confirmation of scope behavior. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that the marketplace/plugin install applies globally across all projects rather than per-repo, and independent/community verification of this scope switch actually working as documented.
